paper.title: Does spatial thinking ability relate to performance when using web-mapping services? A survey with digital natives

claims.claim: The sample's STAT score has mean 10.62 and SD 2.45.
For Group 1 Task 1, success was 35.14% on Google Maps and 86.49% on Bing Maps; McNemar chi-square = 15.43, p < .001.
Group 1 overall task scores differed between Google Maps and Bing Maps: Wilcoxon V = 78, p = .012.
The 95% confidence interval for the Group 1 GM-BM overall score difference is [-1.5, 0.0].
STAT score correlates with Google Maps task score (Kendall's tau = .29, z = 3.19, p = .001).
The script computes the Group 2 analyses and Table 9 correlations for Bing Maps and HERE WeGo.

findings.description: The shipped script terminates at its Google Maps across-groups section because GMHWG is undefined. The Group 2 calculations are explicitly omitted from the script, leaving the available GM_HWG.csv unread and unprocessed. Consequently the remainder of the workflow, including key Table 9 correlations, cannot execute.
findings.evidence: logs/run-04.log records 'SHIPPED_SCRIPT_ERROR: object 'GMHWG' not found'; survey_2021.R lines 761-764 say Group 2 code is omitted and identify GM_HWG.csv as the file to use.
findings.suggested_fix: Publish the omitted Group 2 analysis code and rerun the complete workflow against the shipped data.

findings.description: The lower bound of the Group 1 GM-BM overall score confidence interval differs from Table 4, although the reported Wilcoxon statistic and p-value recur.
findings.evidence: The shipped wilcox.test call returns [-1.0, 0.0] in logs/run-04.log; Table 4 reports [-1.5, 0.0].
findings.suggested_fix: Report the R version used for the published result and verify the interval in that environment; correct the table or document the version-related difference if confirmed.

limitations: Only the shipped Figshare version 1 analysis script and data were used. Their SHA-256 hashes matched the user-supplied values. The current Figshare record has later versions; no later-version files were used.
The workflow is incomplete as shipped. No omitted Group 2 code was authored or inferred, and all downstream values blocked by the error are not_checkable.
This certificate assesses computational reproducibility only; outcome_robustness is not checked.
